definitions.full: H6463. paah [ מָּעָה ] verb groan (onomatopoetic according to Thes; Late Hebrew Hiph`il bleat , so Arabic , , Dozy; Aramaic מְּעָא bleat ,); — Imperfect 1singular אֶפְעֶה כַּיּוֺלֵדָה Isa 42:14 (of ׳י staining himself to deliver Israel, + אֶשֹּׁם [ נשׁם ], אֶשְׁאַף ). — [ אֶפַע ] 41:26 ..
